title: 3. Codebase Understanding & Context Management
description: Master large codebase navigation, AI-powered code discovery, and advanced context management techniques using @folders and multi-file operations.
author: Pekka Kokkonen
learningObjectives: Navigate and understand large codebases efficiently using AI assistance
Use @folders and file referencing for enhanced context management
Apply multi-file operations and cross-file analysis techniques
Implement advanced search and discovery for complex projects
Optimize context for better AI performance in enterprise codebases
keyTopics: Project architecture analysis and pattern recognition
Semantic code search and discovery techniques
Context optimization strategies for large codebases
practicalExamples: Project architecture analysis with comprehensive overview
Cross-file refactoring for API changes and updates
Advanced code discovery and security audit techniques
prerequisites: Experience with medium to large codebases
Familiarity with version control and code review processes
